rules.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
rules.read_back: Whenever the robot fires, the shot's power must be between 0.1 and 3.0 inclusive, and the robot's energy at the start of the turn must be strictly greater than the shot's power.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> (((p.0 as int) >= 100) && ((p.0 as int) <= 3000) && ((obs.energy.0 as int) > (p.0 as int)))
rules.why: Verus returned 'unknown', not a rejection: the rule's firing logic lives in the helper fire_power, which Verus ignores because it sits outside the verus! macro or is marked external, so it could not reason about it. Reading the code, fire_power looks within the rule (it fires only when energy > 100, with power min(3000, energy-1)), but that is my reading, not a proof.

deleted_starters.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.
Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.

explanation.headline: Not proved: Verus could not check rule S1 at all
explanation.summary: Verus did not prove rule S1 (never fire a shot you can't afford). Its verdict was 'unknown' because it cannot use the helper fire_power. The battles reported violations of rules S2 (first at turn 0) and S3 (first at turn 2) in both the open arena and the city map, but those rules are not in the checked rule list, so I can't say what they mean. No S1 violation was reported in either battle.
